title: imap: enable ext_namespace feature on imap-next
description:
Enable the ext_namespace Cargo feature on the imap-next dependency in crates/imap/Cargo.toml. Without this flag, Capability::Namespace, CommandBody::Namespace, and Data::Namespace are all behind #[cfg(feature="ext_namespace")] and do not compile. This is a prerequisite for both the NAMESPACE capability advertisement and the NAMESPACE command handler.

Change: crates/imap/Cargo.toml line ~25:
  imap-next = "0.3.4"
becomes:
  imap-next = { version = "0.3.4", features = ["ext_namespace"] }

Acceptance: cargo build -p stoa-imap succeeds; Capability::Namespace and CommandBody::Namespace are in scope.
